short: clinical-research prose: data/samples from patients, trials, cohorts, registries
notes: Card: max 135, density 0.33%, peaks ' the' (patients from the Glans-Look database), ' from' (data from this trial), 'oma' (Melanoma Task Force), 'ative' (Collaborative Research Group), ' prospective' (trials), 'enter' (multicenter trials), ' for' (demonstration projects in clinics), ' no' (medications in use), 'large' (randomized trials). Probe: 'tumour samples from 212 patients enrolled in the registry' 0.868, 'Data from this trial suggest that oncologists should offer the drug to patients with' 0.541, 'Collaborative Research Group pooled ... nine cohorts' 0.302, 'Three large randomized controlled trials' 0.150, 'no approved medications' 0.065; 'Take one tablet twice a day' 0.005, 'nurse checked his blood pressure' 0.008, 'experiments at the collider' 0.007, 'Data from this survey suggest that commuters' 0.056. So the pole needs patients as research subjects, not medicine or research alone. Fire items: records from 1,240 patients, results from this cohort, blood samples from 86 participants, Research Group, stroke registry, melanoma study, matched controls, phase II enrolment; near misses: four patient-care sentences and four twins with bridges, councils, forest plots and galaxies.
